question: Does the dual-region active-writes proposal being unapproved establish that it was cancelled or that it was never cancelled?

claims.text: The dual-region active-writes proposal was proposed but not approved; the accepted migration uses one writer. This unapproved status does not establish that it was cancelled, nor does it establish that it was never cancelled.
